subject: Aligning ML/Infra runthrough and evaluation plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@catalystai.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@catalystai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning ML/Infra runthrough and evaluation plan

Hi Sophie / Marcus —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goals we heard: validate end-to-end latency and throughput at 8k context for a mix of conversational and retrieval-augmented prompts; confirm data handling and KMS integration; and walk through rollout/rollback plan for a pilot in Q4.
- Recommended next step: a 60–90 minute technical runthrough (ML + infra + engineering) where we: (1) review your current stack and latency targets, (2) run a short live generation/embedding run using your sample prompts, (3) look at observability and cost trade-offs (batching/quantization), and (4) map an MVP rollout and evaluation plan.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Sep 7 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed, Sep 8 — 09:00–10:30
- Fri, Sep 10 — 13:00–14:30

I attached a draft agenda and a small sample prompt set (for the live runs) to help you evaluate timing. If those windows don’t work, feel free to propose alternatives next week.

Attachments: TDX_agenda_draft.pdf (PDF), sample_prompt_set.yaml (YAML)

If this looks good I’ll loop in our infra lead (Vivek) and our senior SE (Marissa) to confirm attendees and the specific model variant we’ll stage for the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.ai)

> Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning...

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap. We’re very interested in the 60–90 minute runthrough; the scope you outlined matches what we want to validate. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Please include a short segment on audit logs / retention and KMS interaction (our security lead wants to see end-to-end flow).
- Marcus and I will also want to understand how continuous batching might affect tail latency for short, high-priority queries — so if you can prepare a short perf comparison (baseline vs batching) that would be ideal.
- Heads-up: our EMEA infra lead may join remotely; please keep the session within the 90-minute cap.

Availability (PT) that works for us: 
- Tue, Sep 7 — 10:00–11:30 (best)
- Wed, Sep 8 — 09:00–10:30 (also OK)

If Tue the 7th is firm on your side, please send a calendar invite. Also share any pre-call artifacts you want us to review.

Thanks,
Sophie Tan

Marissa / Vivek —

Forwarding Sophie's note. She prefers Tue 7th 10:00–11:30 PT but Wed 8th 09:00–10:30 PT is acceptable. Key asks to prep for the session: 

1) Live run: pick a model variant we can stage (recommend gptx-8k-quant or gptx-8k-fp16 fallback). We should have both ready and fall back to FP16 if there’s instability.
2) Perf comparison: short baseline vs continuous-batching numbers (3–4 slides / quick table). Use a small sample of the attached prompt_set.
3) Security: include a 10–12 minute KMS/audit-log walk-through; Vivek, can you confirm who on infra will join and whether we need any pre-demo VPN/VPC access?
4) Logistics: 60–90 minutes total; live runs should be capped at 20 minutes.

I’ve uploaded the draft agenda and prompt set to the deal record (link below) and attached the files to this thread. Please confirm attendees and pick Tue or Wed. If Tue 7th works we’ll send the calendar invite to Catalyst and set a recorder for the session.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Thanks — Aditya

Attachment: TDX_agenda_draft.pdf (PDF), sample_prompt_set.yaml (YAML)

Thanks — Tue, Sep 7 10:00–11:30 PT works for our team; I’ve booked the slot on the calendar (invite link below). Vivek will join for the KMS/audit segment and I’ll run the demo and perf slides. Attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (SE, lead demo), Vivek Kulkarni (Infra lead), Aditya Rao (AM).

- 10:00–10:05 — Intros + goals (Aditya)
- 10:05–10:20 — Architecture and data flow (Vivek)
- 10:20–10:40 — Live generation + embedding runs (Marissa) — use sample_prompt_set.yaml (attached)
